title: Shanghai Relocation & Language Study
description: 100 practical conversations for long-term stay in Shanghai, including student life, housing, and administrative tasks.

sentence.zh: 我想咨询一下中文课程。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zīxún yīxià Zhōngwén kèchéng.
sentence.en: I would like to inquire about Mandarin courses.

sentence.zh: 你们有针对外国学生的长期班吗？
sentence.pinyin: Nǐmen yǒu zhēnduì wàiguó xuéshēng de chángqī bān ma?
sentence.en: Do you have long-term classes for foreign students?

sentence.zh: 课程可以协助办理留学签证吗？
sentence.pinyin: Kèchéng kěyǐ xiézhù bànlǐ liúxué qiānzhèng ma?
sentence.en: Can the course assist with student visa processing?

sentence.zh: 请问这套房子是精装修的吗？
sentence.pinyin: Qǐngwèn zhè tào fángzi shì jīngzhuāngxiū de ma?
sentence.en: Is this apartment fully furnished?
Does the rent include property management fees?

sentence.zh: 房东可以提供办理居住登记的文件吗？
sentence.pinyin: Fángdōng kěyǐ tígōng bànlǐ jūzhù dēngjì de wénjiàn ma?
sentence.en: Can the landlord provide the documents for residence registration?

sentence.zh: 我要去哪里办理临时住宿登记？
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù nǎlǐ bànlǐ línshí zhùsù dēngjì?
sentence.en: Where do I go to register my temporary residence?

sentence.pinyin: Shuǐ, diàn, méiqì fèi zěnme jiāo?
sentence.en: How do I pay for water, electricity, and gas?

sentence.zh: 可以通过支付宝或者微信支付吗？
sentence.pinyin: Kěyǐ tōngguò Zhīfùbǎo huòzhě Wēixìn zhīfù ma?
sentence.en: Can I pay via Alipay or WeChat Pay?
Where is the nearest supermarket?

sentence.zh: 办一张公交地铁卡需要多少钱？
sentence.pinyin: Bàn yī zhāng gōngjiāo dìtiě kǎ xūyào duōshǎo qián?
sentence.en: How much does it cost to get a public transport card?

sentence.zh: 你好，我是刚搬来的邻居。
sentence.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì gāng bān lái de línjū.
sentence.en: Hello, I am a new neighbor who just moved in.

sentence.zh: 这附近有什么好吃的街头小吃？
sentence.pinyin: Zhè fùjìn yǒu shénme hǎochī de jiētóu xiǎochī?
sentence.en: What good street food is there nearby?

sentence.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ shēnqǐng shìtīng kè ma?
sentence.en: Can I apply for a trial class?

sentence.zh: 房间里的空调坏了，能找人修吗？
sentence.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ de kōngtiáo huài le, néng zhǎo rén xiū ma?
sentence.en: The AC in the room is broken, can I find someone to fix it?

sentence.zh: 我的签证快到期了，如何续签？
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ de qiānzhèng kuài dàoqī le, rúhé xùqiān?
sentence.en: My visa is about to expire, how do I renew it?

sentence.zh: 我可以使用共享单车吗？
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ shǐyòng gòngxiǎng dānchē ma?
sentence.en: Can I use shared bikes?
Is this in stock?

sentence.zh: 这附近有没有安静的咖啡馆？
sentence.pinyin: Zhè fùjìn yǒu méiyǒu ānjìng de kāfēiguǎn?
sentence.en: Are there any quiet cafes nearby?

sentence.zh: 家里没电了，怎么查余额？
sentence.pinyin: Jiālǐ méi diàn le, zěnme chá yú'é?
sentence.en: The electricity is out, how do I check the balance?
Does the school have a Mandarin corner?

sentence.zh: 我可以看下合同样本吗？
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ kàn xià hétóng yàngběn ma?
sentence.en: Can I see a sample of the contract?

sentence.zh: 这是我的护照和居留许可。
sentence.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de hùzhào hé jūliú xǔkě.
sentence.en: These are my passport and residence permit.

sentence.zh: 我要去浦东机场，坐地铁怎么走？
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù Pǔdōng jīchǎng, zuò dìtiě zěnme zǒu?
sentence.en: I want to go to Pudong Airport, how do I get there by metro?

sentence.zh: 在哪里可以买到进口食品？
sentence.pinyin: Zài nǎlǐ kěyǐ mǎi dào jìnkǒu shípǐn?
sentence.en: Where can I buy imported food?

sentence.pinyin: Nín zài Shànghǎi zhù duōjiǔ le?
sentence.en: How long have you lived in Shanghai?
Is this snack spicy?

sentence.pinyin: Wǒ de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng shì chūjí.
sentence.en: My Mandarin level is beginner.
Does the apartment have internet service?
What time does the office open?
How do I use the taxi app?

sentence.pinyin: Kěyǐ gěi wǒ yīgè dàizi ma?
sentence.en: Can I have a bag?
Are there any parks nearby?
Why is there no hot water?
Can tuition be paid in installments?
When will the deposit be refunded?
Do I need an appointment?
What time does the metro line stop running?
Is there a discount on this?
Nice to meet you.

sentence.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yī zhāng càidān.
sentence.en: Please give me a menu.
Do I have textbooks?
What floor is the apartment on?
I want to open a bank account.
Can I park here?
Do you accept credit cards?
What are your plans for the weekend?
When will the maintenance person come?

sentence.pinyin: Kètáng shàng yǒu duōshǎo gè xuéshēng?
sentence.en: How many students are there in the class?
Is this residential area safe?
I need to photocopy these materials.
How much longer until we reach the destination?
How is this fruit sold?

sentence.zh: 上海的天气总是这样吗？
sentence.pinyin: Shànghǎi de tiānqì zǒng shì zhèyàng ma?
sentence.en: Is the weather in Shanghai always like this?
Please help me pack this (to go).
I want to take the HSK test.

sentence.pinyin: Zhè fángzi de cǎiguāng hǎo ma?
sentence.en: Is the lighting in this apartment good?
Can I apply for an extension?

sentence.zh: 请问去最近的车站怎么走？
sentence.pinyin: Qǐngwèn qù zuìjìn de chēzhàn zěnme zǒu?
sentence.en: May I ask how to get to the nearest station?
Can I return or exchange the goods?

sentence.zh: 有什么本地的习俗我需要注意吗？
sentence.pinyin: Yǒu shénme běndì de xísú wǒ xūyào zhùyì ma?
sentence.en: Are there any local customs I need to be aware of?
Is the internet speed here fast?

sentence.zh: 老师，我没听懂，能再讲一遍吗？
sentence.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒ méi tīngdǒng, néng zài jiǎng yībiàn ma?
sentence.en: Teacher, I didn't understand, could you explain again?
Are pets allowed here?

sentence.pinyin: Wǒ de cáiliào dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
sentence.en: My materials are all prepared.

sentence.pinyin: Zhè bān chē jīngguò Wàitān ma?
sentence.en: Does this bus pass by the Bund?
Can I pay with cash?
What would you like to drink?
I want an order of fried rice.
Is there homework after class?
Can we share the rent?

sentence.pinyin: Wǒ zài nǎlǐ qǔ wǒ de zhèngjiàn?
sentence.en: Where do I pick up my documents?
Where is the taxi stand nearby?
How much for half a kilo?
Excuse me, sorry to bother you.

sentence.pinyin: Zhèr de diànyā shì 220 fú ma?
sentence.en: Is the voltage here 220V?
Does the school have a library?

sentence.zh: 我们可以实地看一下房子吗？
sentence.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ shídì kàn xià fángzi ma?
sentence.en: Can we see the apartment in person?
Do I need to bring photos?

sentence.pinyin: Zhè lù chē jǐ fēnzhōng yī bān?
sentence.en: How often does this bus run?

sentence.zh: 我想找卖生活用品的店。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo mài shēnghuó yòngpǐn de diàn.
sentence.en: I'm looking for a store that sells daily necessities.

sentence.zh: 这儿附近有好的餐馆吗？
sentence.pinyin: Zhèr fùjìn yǒu hǎo de cānguǎn ma?
sentence.en: Are there any good restaurants nearby?
Please don't add cilantro.
Does the course have a completion certificate?
How much is the property management fee?

sentence.zh: 我不明白这份文件上的要求。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ bù míngbái zhè fèn wénjiàn shàng de yāoqiú.
sentence.en: I don't understand the requirements on this document.

sentence.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī zhāng dìtiě yuèkǎ.
sentence.en: I want to buy a monthly metro pass.
Are there any convenience stores nearby?

sentence.pinyin: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ yīgè máng ma?
sentence.en: Can you do me a favor?
I want to apply for broadband installation.
What days are the classes on?
Does the apartment have a balcony?

sentence.pinyin: Wǒ yào bàobèi wǒ de zhùzhǐ.
sentence.en: I need to report my address.
How long does it take to get to the train station?
Can I try this on?
People here are very friendly.

sentence.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ jiā yīdiǎn shuǐ.
sentence.en: Please add some water for me.
Does the tuition include insurance fees?

sentence.zh: 家具如果损坏了怎么办？
sentence.pinyin: Jiājù rúguǒ sǔnhuài le zěnme bàn?
sentence.en: What if the furniture is damaged?
Thank you for your help.
